# iothub_purge_c2d_queue (Action)

Deletes every pending cloud-to-device message of a device and reports how many were purged.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iothub_device" "sensor" {
  device_id = "sensor-0001"
}

# Drop stale cloud-to-device messages before a device is re-commissioned:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.iothub_purge_c2d_queue.sensor
action "iothub_purge_c2d_queue" "sensor" {
  config {
    device_id = iothub_device.sensor.device_id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) Device ID.

### Optional

- `timeout` (String) Overall deadline for the invocation, for example `30m` (default `10m`). It covers retries of throttled requests.
